summary: Enterprise AI that has to survive a compliance review — governance, PII handling, and LLMs that run inside the customer's own network.

highlights.title: AI Governance & Security
highlights.body: Design and enforce enterprise AI governance policies and guardrails to prevent data leakage and guarantee compliance across model workflows.

highlights.title: PII Protection & Data Privacy
highlights.body: Build robust data anonymisation and privacy layers that intercept and protect Personally Identifiable Information before anything is routed to an external or cloud LLM.

highlights.title: Sovereign & On-Premise LLMs
highlights.body: Deploy, fine-tune and optimise local LLMs on-premise, giving clients full data sovereignty and zero cloud-data exposure.

highlights.title: Enterprise AI Chatbots & RAG
highlights.body: Develop custom conversational assistants integrated with local corporate databases, document repositories and internal knowledge bases.

highlights.title: Cloud & Hybrid AI Architecture
highlights.body: Architect secure pipelines that bridge local workloads with cloud AI providers under strict Data Loss Prevention rules.

org: Educational Technology Department (EduTech UdS), Saarland University
summary: Lead developer on an adaptive self-regulated-learning platform, plus two research pipelines: audio-to-knowledge-graph, and real-time gaze streaming.

highlights.title: SRL Course Platform — full-stack lead
highlights.body: Architected and deployed a production adaptive learning platform (React 19 + TypeScript, Node.js/Express, PostgreSQL 16 with pgvector) serving 50+ university course modules. Authored 18 architecture decision records covering authentication, LLM provider abstraction and data architecture.

highlights.title: Document-ingestion pipeline
highlights.body: Built a Medallion ETL pipeline turning lecture PDFs into searchable learning content — PDF parsing, LLM-driven semantic chunking, then vector embeddings in pgvector. Indexed 1,200+ documents with HNSW; cut manual content-labelling time by 40%.

highlights.title: Hybrid retrieval
highlights.body: Combined pgvector HNSW vector similarity with BM25 full-text search over a PostgreSQL GIN index, fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. 78% retrieval accuracy on the university knowledge base, served from a FastAPI endpoint at sub-200 ms latency.

highlights.title: Adaptive AI tutor
highlights.body: Backend supporting three content-depth levels per concept with pluggable LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama). Per-model cost and latency tracking informs provider selection; response quality measured across 500+ student interactions.

highlights.title: AI Co-Design Platform — NLP pipeline
highlights.body: Built a system converting classroom audio into structured knowledge graphs: OpenAI Whisper speech-to-text, pyannote speaker diarisation, then LLM entity and relation extraction. Processed 45+ hours of lecture audio; outputs versioned in PostgreSQL for team collaboration.

highlights.title: Real-time gaze streaming
highlights.body: Optimised WebSocket-based gaze-data streaming from the Pupil Labs glasses API, reducing end-to-end latency on a custom behavioural data-collection tool.

role: Co-Founder · Advisory Board Member · Technical Lead
summary: A student scientific community I co-founded in 2018. It now has ~200 members and has hosted speakers from Caltech, NASA and other leading research institutions.

highlights.title: Co-founder
highlights.body: Started the community in 2018 and served as Vice President; today I sit on the advisory board as technical lead.

highlights.title: ~200-member scientific community
highlights.body: APS-funded, featuring invited speakers from Caltech, NASA and leading research institutions.

highlights.title: Technical lead
highlights.body: Responsible for the organisation's web presence and technical infrastructure, including a Progressive Web App and a RAG-based knowledge assistant over the community's archives.

org: Computational Interaction Group (CIX), Universität des Saarlandes
summary: A research study on human-computer interaction patterns in mobile text entry — and the computer-vision pipeline that made it measurable.

highlights.title: Computer-vision pipeline
highlights.body: Built a MediaPipe + OpenCV pipeline tracking detailed hand movements during touchscreen typing, enabling precise analysis of finger positioning and movement patterns. Processed 50,000+ behavioural events at 96% hand-posture classification accuracy.

highlights.title: Eliminated the annotation bottleneck
highlights.body: Delivered a production-ready, reproducible dataset pipeline that reduced manual annotation effort by 30% and unblocked PhD-level forecasting research on user interaction patterns.

highlights.title: Statistical analysis
highlights.body: Implemented position-variability metrics, hand-switching detection and suggestion-bar interaction analysis to quantify typing behaviour.

highlights.title: Multi-modal comparison framework
highlights.body: Compared thumb-based against index-finger typing strategies, surfacing differences in spatial distribution, selection accuracy and ergonomic patterns.

highlights.title: Visualisation & data sync
highlights.body: Matplotlib heatmaps, distribution plots and comparative analyses; a processing pipeline synchronising video with keyboard event logs for temporal analysis of typing behaviour.

summary: Fifteen months shipping production front-ends in a cross-functional team, and the place I learned what a design-to-dev handoff actually costs.

highlights.title: Front-end development
highlights.body: Developed components using HTML, JavaScript and React; built responsive interfaces for consistent experience across devices.

highlights.title: Design & handoff
highlights.body: Designed and improved user interfaces in Figma, and collaborated with designers to implement UI components aligned with company branding.

highlights.title: Backend integration
highlights.body: Assisted in integrating backend features using MongoDB and SQL, and wired up REST API and database layers.

highlights.title: Standards
highlights.body: Applied modern UI/UX principles, responsive design techniques and accessibility standards across delivery.

role: Research Intern — Computer Vision & Deep Learning
summary: My first research role: compressing crack-detection CNNs small enough to be useful, without giving up the accuracy that made them worth deploying.

highlights.title: Concrete crack detection at scale
highlights.body: Processed the SDNET2018 dataset — 56,000+ concrete crack images — for CNN-based detection, benchmarking nine architectures.

highlights.title: Knowledge distillation
highlights.body: Transferred knowledge from large teachers (ResNet-50, VGG-19) into lightweight students, improving Matthews Correlation Coefficient by up to 20% while shrinking the deployable model.

highlights.title: Interpretability
highlights.body: Applied Grad-CAM to verify the models were attending to actual cracks rather than background texture; achieved 96% classification accuracy on the test set.
